expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in 'Popular right now' still shows a loading spinner overlaying a partially loaded/blurred image, suggesting the image never finished loading or the spinner isn't dismissed on load.

The third card in 'Fastest near you' has its title clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card itself is cut off flush against the viewport, making it unclear the row is scrollable.
The category filter row ends with an unlabeled chip fragment clipped at the right edge, appearing as an empty grey pill rather than a readable category.
Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart while the second uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
The second 'Popular right now' card (-20% promo) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible restaurant name, and there is no bottom spacing so content appears to sit under the nav.
Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' metadata line uses light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast threshold.
